coin.title: Malta 10 Euro 2022 ‘The Lord of the Rings’ Silver Prooflike PL69
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KV05UV8]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}Your new Malta 10 Euro 2022 'The Lord of the Rings’ Silver Prooflike PL69 is waiting for you. PL69 coins dazzle with rich shine and nearly flawless surfaces. Minor marks are virtually invisible, preserving their brilliance. This coin is a wonderful choice for collectors seeking high visual impact. Design The obverse of the coin shows, in the middle, the White tree of Gondor, the symbol of the continent Gondor, which brought luck, according to the inhabitants. The tree has a color detail. Around the tree is the famous text that is also on the ring. The text says: ‘One Ring to rule them all, one Ring to find them, one Ring to bring them all and in the darkness bind them’. The upper letters are embossed, the bottom letters are a gold color. On the reverse is the logo of the Central Bank of Malta, the privy mark and the year of issue.
